anchor: v1::Priya Raman, order ORD-20533. I tried the handheld GPS on two hikes and it's not for me. I'd like to return it.

result.text: Hi Priya, I'm sorry, but I can't start a return for order ORD-20533. Our system lists the return window for this handheld GPS as 14 days, and it was delivered 18 days ago, so it falls outside that window. I know that's not the answer you were hoping for, and I'm sorry the GPS didn't work out for your hikes. If you'd like, I can check whether any other options apply to this order.
